Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing Kalistar x Chrono Trigger painting while preserving the character identity, pose, complete body anatomy, recognizable clothes, hair, weapon/tool, lighting direction, framing and all foreground brushwork. Keep the exact same overall scene.
Change only these two aspects:
1. Repaint the facial features in a naturalistic hand-painted Kalistar manner: normal human-sized eyes and irises, fine subtle eyelids without thick black anime lash outlines, credible nose and cheek planes and chin. Keep the character's age, expression, hair, and glasses if present. Not a photograph: the face must share the visible painterly strokes of the surrounding clothes and landscape. No smooth airbrushed skin and no cartoon or manga features.
2. Simplify the DISTANT background by removing the distant towers, castle, walls and small architecture visible behind the character. Replace just that distant area with broad atmospheric sky/mist planes appropriate to this same scene. Keep the near stone step/tree/workshop machine and the character unchanged. No added props, buildings, people or effects.
Portrait standalone painting. Do not crop closer, do not shrink limbs, do not alter the character design, no text or frame.
